subject.title: [Feature]: Settings profile page — lifetime token stats, streaks, and activity heatmap

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a new Control UI settings profile page backed by lifetime usage aggregates, or should this feature be deferred or declined?
rationale: The request is VISION-aligned but adds a new core UI route and gateway response fields, and the issue carries a protected maintainer label with an active implementation PR awaiting review.

options.title: Review linked core PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102842 as the candidate implementation and decide the UI/API shape there before closing this issue.

options.title: Defer the profile surface
options.body: Close or pause the issue and linked PR if maintainers do not want this glanceable lifetime-stats page in core right now.

recommendation.title: Review linked core PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102842 as the candidate implementation and decide the UI/API shape there before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is both a high-signal recent Control UI contributor in the sampled history and the issue opener for this product direction.
